_readme: Golden snapshot of every command DispatchSEO hands an owner. Regenerate with `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/agent-golden.mjs` and commit the diff alongside the change that caused it. Never edit by hand.

claude.connect: claude mcp add dispatchseo-goldensite https://backend.example.test/api/mcp --transport http --scope local --header "Authorization: Bearer fixture-token-do-not-use" && mkdir -p .claude && test -f .claude/settings.local.json || printf '%s\n' '{' '  "permissions": {' '    "allow": ["Bash(gh *)"]' '  }' '}' > .claude/settings.local.json

claude.setup: curl -fsSL https://backend.example.test/setup.sh | bash -s -- fixture-token-do-not-use goldensite https://backend.example.test 0
claude.setupBundled: curl -fsSL https://backend.example.test/setup.sh | bash -s -- fixture-token-do-not-use goldensite https://backend.example.test 1
claude.setupPowershell: $b = "$env:ProgramFiles\Git\bin\bash.exe"; if (!(Test-Path $b)) { $b = "$env:LocalAppData\Programs\Git\bin\bash.exe" }; if (!(Test-Path $b)) { "Git (with Git Bash) is required - install it from https://git-scm.com/downloads/win and run this again" } else { & $b -c 'curl -fsSL https://backend.example.test/setup.sh | bash -s -- fixture-token-do-not-use goldensite https://backend.example.test 0' }
